create_seed_oss_tool_parser: create a SeedOssToolParser instance to parse XML-style tool calls from vLLM model output
test_extract_tool_calls: test extract_tool_calls to parse <seed:tool_call> blocks and extract function names with typed arguments
test_extract_tool_calls_streaming: test extract_tool_calls_streaming to incrementally parse streaming tool calls with function and parameter deltas
parse_xml_function_call: parse an XML function call string into a ToolCall with typed parameter values converted from config
summarize_seed_oss_tool_parser: summarize the SeedOssToolParser class that parses seed-oss XML format tool calls from LLM responses
